content:
Ben Carter: Heads up — final review for onboarding email v1 before we schedule for tomorrow AM. Need approvals on:
1) subject line A/Bs (welcome + quickstart)
2) suppression rules (esp. opted-out + already activated)
3) launch checklist sign-off

Doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/gtm/onboarding-email-copy-v1 (see tab “Subject lines + variants”)

Proposed subject A/Bs:
Email 1 (Welcome):
A: “Welcome to Redwood — your API key + first call in 5 min”
B: “Get to your first successful inference call (5 min)”

Email 2 (Quickstart):
A: “Copy/paste quickstart: first response + streaming”
B: “Your first response is close — try streaming + cost view”

Please drop :thumbsup: or edits by EOD. We’re trying to lock by 4pm PT.

Tyler Benson: On suppression — current audience query is:
- signup in last 72h
- NOT `first_request_success` (2xx completion)
- NOT hard-bounced / unsubscribed
- NOT internal / test domains

Also adding suppression for anyone who triggered `api_key_created` but then `first_request_success` within 30 min (prevents “you’re stuck” vibe if they already got through).

Open question: do we suppress if `first_request_success` happens AFTER send but BEFORE open/click? (We can’t reliably cancel at the MTA level, but we can gate some deep links with console states.)

Soojin Lee: Subject lines: I’m good with the “API key + first call” framing. That’s concrete and dev-first.

Minor tweak: “in 5 min” can feel salesy if someone takes longer. Can we do “in ~5 min” or “in a few minutes”? I’d prefer we keep it truthful.

Also, for Email 2, B reads a little naggy (“close”). I’d lean:
B alt: “Next: streaming + cost dashboard (quickstart inside)”

(reactions: Ben Carter :eyes:)

Camila Reyes: +1 on removing the hard “5 min” claim. Our exec visibility on deliverability/compliance is high this week.

On suppressions — please triple-check opt-out handling. We cannot repeat the issue from last quarter.

Dev Patel: Jumping in from Support guardrails side — if Email 2 pushes streaming, can we include the troubleshooting link in the body preview text? That’s the #1 ticket generator when folks see disconnects.

Also request: suppression for anyone who clicked “Contact support” in console in last 24h (don’t pile on while they’re already frustrated).

Ben Carter: Good call. We can add preview text w/ troubleshooting.

Tyler — can we add suppression: `support_link_clicked` within last 24h? Or do we only have that event in console nudge v1?

Tyler Benson: We do have it from the console telemetry hook (PR went in last week). Event name is `console_support_link_clicked` w/ property `source=banner|checklist|help_menu`. I can wire it into the suppression segment.

On the “cancel after activation” question: we can’t stop already-queued sends, but we *can* reduce the issue by only scheduling the next email if they haven’t activated at send-time (SendGrid automation check). The first email (welcome) will still go out on signup regardless.

Ethan Wallace: Re: benchmark proof points — just make sure we’re not implying “fastest” etc. If we reference performance at all, link to the public benchmark page.

If you want a lightweight line, approved wording is: “Production-tuned inference with transparent latency/cost breakdowns.”

Soojin Lee: +1. Please avoid “best-in-class” / “fastest” in subject lines.

For Email 1 subject, here are my edits:
A: “Welcome to Redwood — your API key + first call in a few minutes”
B: “Get to your first successful inference call (quickstart inside)”

For Email 2:
A: “Copy/paste quickstart: first response + streaming” (ok)
B: “Next: streaming + cost dashboard (quickstart inside)”

Ben Carter: Works for me. Tyler, can you update the doc and paste final here?

Tyler Benson: Updated in Drive.
Final subject line tests:
Email 1:
A: “Welcome to Redwood — your API key + first call in a few minutes”
B: “Get to your first successful inference call (quickstart inside)”

Email 2:
A: “Copy/paste quickstart: first response + streaming”
B: “Next: streaming + cost dashboard (quickstart inside)”

Suppression rules final (automation):
- global unsub + hard bounce suppression (SendGrid)
- suppress internal/test domains (rule list)
- suppress if `first_request_success` occurred before scheduled send time
- suppress if `console_support_link_clicked` in last 24h
- suppress if user has billing on file (to avoid spamming paying users; they get the customer lifecycle track)

Also setting throttle: 30k/hr, monitor spam complaints + unsub rate hourly.

Camila Reyes: Approved from my side assuming opt-out is confirmed.

Can you paste the launch checklist items and owners here so we have a single thread for “go/no-go”? 

Ben Carter: Launch checklist (tomorrow 9:30am PT send window):
- [x] Copy final (Soojin)
- [x] Benchmark wording + links (Ethan)
- [ ] Suppression segment QA in SendGrid + backfill test (Tyler) — due 3pm
- [ ] Link check (console routes + UTM params) (Ben) — due 3:30pm
- [ ] Support heads-up + macro ready (Dev) — due EOD
- [ ] Deliverability monitor dashboard pinned (Tyler) — due 4pm

Go/no-go at 4:30pm PT.

Dev Patel: Support: I’ll post a short note in #support with expected questions + the troubleshooting link. Also adding a canned reply for “why did I get this email?” + opt-out instructions.

Soojin Lee: Approving copy + subjects as written. :thumbsup:

One more minor: email preview text for Email 1 should mention “If you already shipped your first call, you can ignore this.” Helps reduce annoyance.

Tyler Benson: QA update:
- Ran 20 test contacts across states (unsubscribed, activated, support click, billing added) and suppression behaved as expected.
- Verified List-Unsubscribe header present.
- Verified UTM mapping: `utm_source=lifecycle_email&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=onboarding_v1&utm_content={{variant}}`

Only outstanding: link check for console path `/console/projects/*/api-keys` vs new route. Ben, please confirm.

Ben Carter: Link check done. The API key CTA now points to `/console/api-keys` (no project required) to avoid 404s. Quickstart CTA goes to docs page updated in the docs PR.

Camila Reyes: :thumbsup: Go from me.

Tyler Benson: Scheduling now for 9:30am PT. Will watch:
- unsubscribe rate (guardrail 0.35%)
- spam complaints
- bounce rate
- activation delta within 24h for recipients vs holdout

SendGrid Bot: Campaign “onboarding_v1_email_1” scheduled for 2025-01-23 09:30 PT. Audience size: 48,216. Holdout: 5%. Throttle: 30,000/hr.

Ben Carter: Thanks all. If anything looks off tomorrow (complaints, weird replies), drop it here + tag me/Tyler. We'll pause fast if needed.
